name: smoother-deepseek-harness
description: 【推荐官方桌面端安装】你的DSH——比想象的更丝滑！本整合包添加了dsh-smooth-stream插件使流式输出更丝滑，添加dsh-client-ui-task-board插件添加方便的任务看板，添加底部信息栏插件、小鯨鱼插件为工作区增添趣味，以及dsh-pack-plugin管理整合包。添加20个skill用于优化以及编码指导。
author: HXH
patch:
# Your patch layer for this dsh profile, applied after every bundle layer:
# a top-level YAML array of loader patch entries (id-targeted config
# overrides, disables, and insert lists; `!!js` expressions allowed).
- id: ui-settings-account
  name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings-account"
  config:
    version: 1
    step: done
    purpose: null
    process: standard
    completion: skipped
    usage: compact
    developerTools: false
- id: ui-chat
  name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-chat"
  config:
    transcriptView: standard
    performanceUsage: compact
- id: ui-settings
  name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings"
  config:
    enabled: false
- id: agent-default-model
  name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-default-model"
  config:
    provider: deepseek-account
    model: deepseek-flash
    reasoningEffort: high
